v1_defects: v1 declared per-role caps of 16 (mainline) and 2 (control members); the Stage-09 RunIdentity embeds the process thread cap, so child runtime recomputation could not equal the parent runtime_sha256 and the control closure fails closed
v1 rationale contradicted itself: it first stated bit-exact cross-run reproducibility as the previous policy, then claimed cross-machine bit-exactness was never claimed
v1 declared prediction_replay_atol_zero, but the implemented verifiers use 1e-12 for LightGBM and 1e-5 for neural sequence replay

amended.cap_source: protocols/route_a_numerical_policy_v2.json (ambient value must equal the frozen role cap; the environment variable can never define the policy)

rationale: The Stage-09 RunIdentity embeds the numerical runtime contract, and worker processes recompute it and require exact equality with the parent. Per-role thread caps therefore cannot coexist with a single parent identity: every process in a run must use the same cap. v2 freezes cap 8 for all Stage-09/09b/16/25 roles, enforces the cap from the policy document (not the ambient environment), records the implemented replay tolerances, and preserves all scientific inputs. This amendment concerns execution evidence only; no scientific input changes.
